title: fleet skills: each repo's rules move back to its own repo, the cloud checklist skills state only differences, and dogfood-verification is updated (step 7)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Filing gate: child of epic #35205, filed by seat 1. Ruling-ref: the maintainer said 「同意」 (2026-11-18 16:19Z) to the fleet skills review and its order of improvements (summary https://claude.ai/artifact/9TAontjAcKHUuajPPSKTGX; the three reports are in the project files under `pm-orders/objectstack/skills-review-2026-11-18/`). ⛔ Not a claim.

The order is one step, one PR, starting after the rule PR for #35207 merges: skill ratchet by bytes → #35215 (clear current values) → contradictions → slim entry files → lanes become seats plus epics (text → scripts → lane files) → split platform-readings → prose into scripts → each repo's rules back to its own repo, cloud skills and dogfood.

Blocked-by: #35237

## What to do

Step 7. Ruled 2026-11-18 16:19–16:20Z: 「cloud 是不是应该放回cloud仓库」「包括 hotcrm 每个仓库的规则都在自己仓库」. objectstack's pm-dispatch keeps only the mechanisms every repo shares (the seat protocol, the label-write and first-touch scripts, the general part of the grade table). Each repo's own rules live in that repo: its area set, core features, grading details, seat charter, CI and verification, release aftercare.

- The cloud lane rules already move to the cloud repository on cloud#4870 (`docs/strategy/triage-rules.md` beside `core-functions.md`). This card checks what is left: the cloud part of `release-aftercare.md` goes to cloud, `lanes/hotcrm.md` to hotcrm, `lanes/mobile.md` to mobile. One PR per repo, and objectstack keeps a one-line pointer for each.
- The two cloud skills (`checklist-author`, `checklist-test` in the cloud repository) state only how they differ from the objectstack versions and point at those for the rest.
- `dogfood-verification` is brought up to date with the current app and boot path.

The PRs in other repos follow those repos' rules for when they may land.

## Done when

Every repo-specific rule lives in its own repo with a pointer from objectstack, the cloud skills carry only their differences, dogfood-verification matches today's app, and every touched repo's skill gates pass.
